title: Lazar's Bendix Field Engineering badge as an intelligence cover

tellings.quote: We knew what that meant. And then when I saw Lazar's ID briefly in one book, there was a photo. There was a copy of it and I saw it and I said, "Holy [ __ ] Lazar worked for Bendix Field Engineering. That was his cover then.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site near Area 51, the Air Force's secret test base in Nevada, carried an ID badge from a company called Bendix Field Engineering, and the claim is that this badge was an intelligence cover. The author Peter Levenda, who writes on intelligence history, tells Michels he saw a copy of the ID in a book and thought, "Lazar worked for Bendix Field Engineering. That was his cover then," saying people in his circle "knew what that meant". If so, Lazar was placed where he was by an intelligence service rather than simply hired.
